SHL.Conflict: {module} also zooms Foundry's image windows. Handout Lens leaves those windows to it, the handout folder still works.

uiLanguage.name: Module language
uiLanguage.hint: Language of Handout Lens on this device. "Like Foundry" follows Foundry's language.

theme.name: Look
theme.hint: Signature shows the transcript and the handout folder on warm paper, Foundry keeps them dark like the rest of Foundry.

enabled.name: Zoom and lens in image windows
enabled.hint: Every image window gets zoom, lens, reading aids and reading sections. Off: Foundry's plain image window.

toolbar.name: Toolbar
toolbar.hint: The toolbar at the bottom of the picture can fade while the mouse rests, or always stay visible.

maxZoom.name: Largest zoom
maxZoom.hint: How far a picture can be enlarged, as a multiple of its own pixels (8 means 800 %).

lensSize.name: Lens size
lensSize.hint: Diameter of the magnifying lens in pixels.

lensZoom.name: Lens strength
lensZoom.hint: How much the lens enlarges at first. Shift and the mouse wheel change it while the lens shows.

showMarkers.name: Number the reading sections
showMarkers.hint: Small numbers on the picture show where the reading sections are. A click jumps to one.

rememberView.name: Remember the view
rememberView.hint: When a picture opens again on this device, it shows the same part, angle and reading aids as last time.

resolutionHint.name: Warn about small pictures
resolutionHint.hint: Only for GMs: a note when a picture is too small to read its text when enlarged, or so large that it loads slowly.

collectShared.name: Collect shown pictures
collectShared.hint: Every picture the GM shows to a player goes into that player's handout folder, so it can be opened again later.

lateJoinMinutes.name: Show to late players (minutes)
lateJoinMinutes.hint: A player who connects within this time after the GM showed a picture gets it too. 0 switches this off.

Viewer.stage: Picture. Wheel zooms, dragging moves, double click zooms in or out, Shift shows the lens.

Nav.count: {count} reading sections, start with the first

Hud.draw: Click the corners of the note one after the other, the frame takes its slant. Or drag a straight frame.
Hud.corners: {count} of 4 corners. Click the next one, a click on the first corner or Enter closes the frame, a right click takes one back.
Hud.leading: Players with this picture follow your view
Hud.smallHint: Small writing in this picture becomes blurry when players enlarge it. A larger scan or export helps.
Hud.hugeHint: Players with slow connections or weak graphics may wait a while for this picture.

Panel.title: Transcript
Panel.nothingToRead: There is nothing to read aloud here.

Edit.title: Edit handout
Edit.hint: Reading sections let players page through a picture: each section is enlarged and turned straight. Players see the titles and transcripts.
Edit.frames: Drag a frame to move it. The selected frame has handles: the squares change its size, the round one above it turns it (Shift: steps of 5 degrees).
Edit.turnHandle: Drag to turn, hold Shift for steps of 5 degrees
Edit.tooSmall: This frame is too small to be a reading section. Zoom out a little and draw it again.
Edit.limit: A picture can have at most {count} reading sections.
Edit.saveFailed: The handout could not be saved.

Folder.title: Handout folder
Folder.menuHint: Every picture you were shown or kept, to open again.
Folder.empty: No handouts yet. When the GM shows you a picture, it lands here.
Folder.name: Name
Folder.saveFailed: The handout folder could not be saved.

Share.view: The players see the picture at your zoom.
Share.closed: The picture was closed for everyone.
Share.small: This picture has only {w} × {h} pixels. Small writing in it becomes blurry when players enlarge it.
Share.huge: This picture has {w} × {h} pixels and may take a while to load for players.

Control.lead: Players follow my view (on or off)
Control.shareView: Show to players at this zoom
Control.noViewer: Handout Lens is switched off for this window.

SELFTEST.Title: Handout Lens self test
SELFTEST.Hint: Checks the image window, the storage and a test viewer. The result appears as a whisper in the chat.
SELFTEST.Popout: Foundry's image window was not found.
SELFTEST.Share: Foundry's function to show pictures was not found.
SELFTEST.Socket: The connection to the server is missing.
SELFTEST.Conflict: {module} also zooms image windows, so the viewer stays off.
SELFTEST.Disabled: Zoom and lens are switched off in the settings of this device.
SELFTEST.Viewer: The test viewer did not start.
SELFTEST.NoFullscreen: This browser does not allow full screen here, the reading mode fills the window instead.
SELFTEST.NewVersions: Handout Lens was verified with an older Foundry version ({versions}). Run the self test in the module settings to check it.

DEBUG.Title: Debug file
DEBUG.Hint: Saves one file for bug reports about all of Sephral’s modules in this world: versions, settings and what the modules recorded, such as the latest chat messages they read. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
DEBUG.Saved: Debug file {file} saved. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
